About

How I got here

I started coordinating events I wanted to share fun activities while engaging a community. As a chapter leader with Artify4Kids, I built a team from scratch, tracked down supplies with a week's notice more times than I can count, and learned how to keep an event fun and seamless.

Along the way I partnered regularly with organizations bringing free arts programming to children:

  • Discovery Cube
  • Families Forward
  • Boys & Girls Club
  • Miracles for Kids

I've always loved documenting my life, so naturally I found myself picking up a camera at events as well.

What I bring to an event

  • Leading and coordinating volunteer teams
  • Last-minute problem solving when plans change
  • Sourcing supplies and materials on tight timelines
  • Building and maintaining NGO partnerships
  • Documenting the day through photography
